sloka: सा तु तारा अधिप मुखी रावणेन निरीक्ष्य तम् ।गृध्र राजम् विनिहतम् विललाप सुदुःखिता ॥३-५२-१॥
transliteration: sā tu tārā adhipa mukhī rāvaṇena nirīkṣya tam ।gṛdhra rājam vinihatam vilalāpa suduḥkhitā ॥3-52-1॥

translations.english: Sita,whose face was like the lord of the stars (Moon), saw Jatayu, king of birds, struck down by Ravana, and lamented in extreme grif :
